_: How the vendor is asked where its limit stands.
The figure is only on the status line, and the status line is only drawn
where there is a terminal, so this is a session with a terminal attached
rather than the one-shot invocation claude.json describes.
'settings' names a file this writes, holding the status line command.
Nothing else is loaded: a person's own settings can hold anything, and a
session that stops to complain about them never draws a status line.
'prompt' is sent once because the limit is not known until an answer has
come back from the vendor. 'trusts' and 'ready' are what the screen says
at the two moments this has to type something; they are the vendor's
words and change when the vendor changes them.
